answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, slashed on a failed audit. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The ledge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the gale. Reaching the falcon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
